info.description: ประกาศด่วน (TOR — a fast-publish path that skips the public-site static rebuild entirely: the banner is fetched live by the browser, not baked into build output, so toggling it live is a normal Strapi publish, not a 20s-debounced multi-minute site rebuild). At most one row per tenant by convention, enforced by the editor UI, not the schema.

active.description: Whether the banner is currently shown on the public site.

url.description: Optional "read more" link — left blank shows text only.
